title: Distilling Multi-Teacher Scoring Principles for Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.29063v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series anomalies take diverse forms, and individual detectors encode different anomaly scoring principles that rarely cover all anomaly types. Recent unsupervised time-series anomaly detectors provide complementary scoring signals, yet deploying them as an ensemble preserves the inference and maintenance cost of every individual detector. We study whether heterogeneous teacher detectors can be distilled into a single lightweight detector in the unsupervised setting, where no anomaly labels are available to define a shared target. AnoMix addresses this by extracting weak pairwise supervision from the training-set anomaly scores of frozen teachers. It normalizes each teacher score sequence independently and trains the student with CoRank, a multi-teacher ranking-distillation objective that converts teacher score gaps into pairwise supervision through teacher consensus. translated_title: 面向无监督时间序列异常检测的多教师评分原则蒸馏
translated_abstract: 时间序列异常具有多种多样的形式，而单个检测器所编码的异常评分原则往往难以覆盖所有异常类型。近期的无监督时间序列异常检测器能够提供互补的评分信号，但将它们作为集成部署时，仍会保留每个单独检测器的推理和维护成本。我们研究在无监督设置下——即没有异常标签可用于定义共享目标时——能否将异构的教师检测器蒸馏为单个轻量级检测器。AnoMix通过从冻结教师模型的训练集异常评分中提取弱成对监督来解决这一问题。它对每个教师的评分序列独立进行归一化，并使用CoRank——一种多教师排序蒸馏目标——来训练学生模型，该目标通过教师共识将教师评分差距转化为成对监督。在七个基准数据集上，AnoMix成功地将协同互补的教师信号整合到了单个学生检测器中。
tldr: AnoMix提出了一种无监督多教师蒸馏框架，利用CoRank多教师排序蒸馏目标，将多个异构异常检测器的互补评分原则蒸馏进单个轻量级学生检测器，无需任何异常标签即在七个基准数据集上实现有效整合。
en_tdlr: AnoMix distills complementary scoring principles from multiple heterogeneous teacher detectors into a single lightweight student for unsupervised time series anomaly detection, using a multi-teacher ranking-distillation objective (CoRank) that converts teacher score gaps into pairwise supervision via teacher consensus without any anomaly labels.
